setting: Haulage yard, North London, England, 4 a.m., rain. We are in the transport office: Mick's desk, base radio, PC.

MICK.name: Eastend Steve (Cockney)
MICK.note: user's pick; night planner, Harry's dad, room voice

HARRY.name: Harry (East London, 20s)
HARRY.note: user's pick; renamed from Gaz; radio from the cab

LEE.name: Jim (old East End)
LEE.note: driver of 14, desk phone on speaker

lines.text: Thirty-one's on, Dad. Bay next to Lee's. It's freezing down this end.
Mirrors, Harry, not your phone. And text your mum when you get to Leeds, or she'll be ringing me, and nobody wants that.
Yes, Dad. It's me first run on me own, not me first day at school.
Go on, then. Go and make your old man proud.
Transport, Mick.
Mick, it's Lee.
Lee! You come back for your sarnies?
Has anyone opened fourteen?
Screen says its doors opened twenty minutes ago. Why?
It listened to me. All the way back down the M1, I had the CB on, and it listened.
lines.say: It listened to me. All the way back down the M one, I had the CB on, and it listened.

lines.text: It knows my name now. Don't let it hear anybody's name.
Lee, what's in—
Twenty minutes ago.
Gatehouse. Go and look at fourteen.
Gatehouse? Since when am I gatehouse? Going.
Fourteen's wide open. There's frost on the floor, Mick. In November. It ain't a fridge.
There's writing in it. Like someone's done it with their finger. Lee. Lee. Lee. Over and over.
And there's another one, under the rest. Fresh. Five letters.
Read it.
It's your boy's, Mick.
Driver of thirty-one. Pull over.
Driver of thirty-one? Dad, you've been on nights too long. I'm on the M1, I'm behind already.
lines.say: Driver of thirty-one? Dad, you've been on nights too long. I'm on the M one, I'm behind already.

lines.text: Just do it, son. Please.
Thirty-one. Rear doors opened.
Your back doors have opened. Stay in the cab. Lock it.
Opened? At fifty-six? Right. Pulling onto the hard shoulder. I'll have a look.
Doors are shut, Dad. Seal's gone, though.
Dad. Did you just say my name?
No.
Someone did.
Harry?
Thirty-one. Rear doors opened.
Rear doors closed.

notes.rule: after f11 Mick never says a name on the radio until f31
notes.user: Mick = Eastend Steve, son = Harry (voice and name)
